name: NitroPack
couldBuild: A caching plugin that stores rendered HTML and serves it early.
stillMissing: NitroPack is not really a plugin — it is their edge network doing the optimisation and serving the result. The plugin is a client for it. Rebuild the client and you have an empty pipe.
requirements: Full-page HTML caching with separate cache buckets for logged-in users, cart and checkout
Critical CSS extraction per template, with the rest deferred
Image lazy-loading plus WebP/AVIF conversion on upload
Cache invalidation on post save, comment, term change and WooCommerce stock updates
A purge-all admin action and WP-CLI command
